blocks.text: Ariana Grande and the cast of Focker-in-Law premiered their film for UK audiences, reuniting at the Odeon Luxe Leicester Square in London, England.
Other stars who joined Grande were Skyler Gisondo, Ben Stiller, Beanie Feldstein, Robert De Niro and Eduardo Franco.
The fourth installment of the Fockers franchise opens in theaters on November 25.

blocks.text: Focker-in-Law follows Greg Focker (Stiller) as he continues to act as a helicopter parent to his two adult kids. In the latest installment, Greg’s anxieties spiral out of control when his son Henry (Superman’s Skyler Gisondo) brings home a formidable new girlfriend, Olivia (Grande), to celebrate the 80th birthday of Greg’s still-intimidating father-in-law, Jack Byrnes (De Niro).

Greg’s concerns skyrocket when Olivia is embraced by everyone, including Jack, and Henry reveals that he plans to propose. Certain that Olivia is hiding something, Greg attempts to unmask her, leading to a calamitous weekend that sees the rivalry between the two future in-laws escalate from an airplane to the kitchen to the bike path.

blocks.text: The executive producers for Focker-in-Law include Nancy Tenenbaum, Amy Herman, Lauren Hennessey, Michelle Graham, and Berry Welsh. Universal Pictures and Paramount Pictures present a Tribeca/Red Hour/Delirious Media/Particular Pictures production of a John Hamburg film.
